title: Scalar compatibility of the explicit integral reindexing composite
statement: Fix a prime l, an arbitrary scheme isomorphism g:X→Y with l invertible on both schemes, native normalized realizations R,S, RingReindex B and IntegralReindex I(E) for every finite coefficient field. For E⊆L and integral constructible K at E, let P=(E,Q_E K) and t=isoToStage(P,E⊆L). The explicit comparison c_E constructed in [lem-sf-adic-realization-reindex-components] satisfies (commonStageDerivedPullback(g)⋙ordinary(R))(t) ≫ c_L(P.toStage) = c_E(K) ≫ (ordinary(S)⋙derivedPull(B))(t). Here c_L is its uniquely specified rational-stage extension. This only asserts the coefficient-enlargement square of already constructed components; it does not construct or assume any common-stage natural isomorphism.

The coefficient_scalar equations identify the structural maps. The representative equations transport this cochain equality through the actual derived computation counits. Raw localization preserves this equality and the component specification of the rational comparison supplies the displayed c_L.

lean.statement:
theorem realizationIntegralReindex_scalar (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (R : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l X)
    (S : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l Y)
    (B : RingReindex l X g R S) (I : ∀ E, IntegralReindex l X g B E)
    (E L : Index l (PadicAlgCl l)) (h : E ≤ L)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) Y) :
    let P := (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := Y) E).obj
        ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) Y).obj K)
    let t := (stageSystem l (PadicAlgCl l) Y).isoToStage P h
    (commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g ⋙ ordinary l X R).map t.hom ≫
        (realizationRationalReindex l g R S B L (I L)).hom.app (P.toStage h) =
      (realizationIntegralReindex l g R S B E (I E)).hom.app K ≫
        (ordinary l Y S ⋙ derivedPull l X g B).map t.hom
